votes.quote: Likely bug I left out of the tests: when an absolute path ends in a marker, like `/Users/me/code`, the function returns an empty string. The check `index <= parts.length - 1` is always true, so the empty remainder after the marker is returned. The dash-encoded branch uses `<` instead: it skips that marker and returns `Users-me-code`. I didn't write a test that locks in the empty string. Tell me what `/Users/me/code` should return and I'll fix it and add the test.
